method: Cited-sources profile. The lister took every checkable statement from the page text. Two passes with a strong model over saved copies only, no live fetch: a prove pass (does the saved copy of THAT cited source carry the same figure, date, entity, measure or words) and a disprove pass (does a cited source or the page itself say the opposite). Verdict rule: CONTRADICTED if the disprove pass found a contradiction, else EVIDENCED if the prove pass found an artefact, else NO EVIDENCE PUBLISHED. A holdout graded by the orchestrator before any pass result gated each run (see gates). This is a check of the brief against its own sources, not an independent audit. Sources [3] and [7] (sec.gov, HTTP 403 to the fetch that saves copies) were read through a summarising fetch tool: the quotes that cite them rest on that tool's text, with no saved body and no hash (copy: none in the manifest), so the checker cannot test them.
